landing_problem_subheading: Every year, millions make critical decisions with generic advice that doesn't reflect who they truly are.
landing_problem_academic_mismatch_descri: Students choose faculties based on family pressure or surface-level tests — not on their actual strengths, interests, or long-term ambitions.
landing_problem_decision_paralysis_descr: With hundreds of pathways and conflicting advice, most people freeze. The options feel endless and the right answer invisible.
landing_problem_personalized_guidance_de: Traditional counseling can't scale. Most students never receive advice genuinely tailored to who they are — and what they could become.
landing_how_it_works_step1_description: Complete a guided assessment covering interests, strengths, and goals. Designed for real alignment — not surface-level personality tests.
landing_how_it_works_step2_description: AICA maps your profile against 200+ curated pathways with full transparency. You always understand why a path was suggested.
landing_how_it_works_step3_description: Receive a concrete action plan: faculties, courses, skills to build, and next steps — all tailored to your exact profile.
landing_roadmap_description: After your assessment, AICA generates a step-by-step plan tailored to your exact profile — not a template, a personalized roadmap you can start following today.
landing_roadmap_feature_1: Clear steps from where you are to where you want to be
landing_roadmap_feature_2: Specific courses, certifications, and skills per step
landing_roadmap_feature_3: Progress tracking as your goals evolve over time
landing_feature_profile_description: Structured inputs capturing interests, strengths, values, and goals — going far beyond surface-level personality tests.
landing_feature_matching_description: Profile-based rules compare you against 200+ pathways with full transparency — you always see why each path was recommended.
landing_feature_ai_explanation_descripti: Every recommendation comes with personalized reasoning, helping you understand and own your decision completely.
landing_feature_roadmaps_description: Concrete next steps, suggested qualifications, and skill-building plans tailored to your specific chosen path.
landing_feature_learning_description: Discover relevant courses, certifications, and resources filtered to your level and available time commitment.
landing_feature_progress_description: Monitor your exploration journey, revisit past assessments, and update your profile as your goals evolve.
for_who_students_description: You're entering higher education and the pressure to pick the right major is overwhelming. AICA helps you choose based on who you actually are.
for_who_graduates_description: You've completed your studies. AICA maps your skills and interests to real career opportunities you can actually pursue.
for_who_career_description: Ready for a new direction but unsure where to start? AICA builds a transition plan from where you are to where you want to be.
testimonial_1_quote: I was completely stuck between Engineering and Product Design for two years. AICA helped me see that my strengths pointed clearly toward HCI. Best decision I've made.
testimonial_2_quote: After 6 years in accounting I needed a change but had no idea where to start. The roadmap AICA gave me helped me transition into data analytics in under a year.
testimonial_2_role: Data Analyst at a FinTech startup
testimonial_3_quote: Every counselor told me to 'follow my passion' with no guidance. AICA showed me specific faculties, why they fit me, and exactly what skills to build first.

pathway_assessment_welcome_title: Find a study or career path that fits you
pathway_assessment_welcome_description: Answer 9 short questions about your strengths, interests, and goals. AICA will turn your answers into clear pathway matches, honest explanations, and a personalized next-step roadmap.
pathway_assessment_welcome_helper: There are no right or wrong answers. Choose what feels genuinely true to you right now.
pathway_assessment_strengths_title: When you are working well, what is happening?
pathway_assessment_strengths_helper: Choose up to 3 — what actually feels natural, not what sounds impressive.
pathway_assessment_strength_problem_solv: You find satisfaction in breaking something complex down until it makes sense.
pathway_assessment_strength_creativity_d: Your default mode is imagination — you see what could exist, not just what does.
pathway_assessment_strength_people_descr: You read rooms well and know how to make others feel understood.
pathway_assessment_strength_analytical_d: You spot patterns others miss and trust data and logic over gut feeling.
pathway_assessment_strength_communicatio: You turn complex ideas into something clear, memorable, and easy to act on.
pathway_assessment_strength_hands_on_des: You need to see, touch, or make something — thinking without doing feels incomplete.
pathway_assessment_strength_fast_learnin: You get up to speed fast and hit your stride in unfamiliar territory.
pathway_assessment_strength_organized_de: You plan before you act and stay consistent until the job is done.
pathway_assessment_passions_helper: Choose up to 3 — what you actually spend time on, not what you think you should care about.
pathway_assessment_passion_tech_descript: You enjoy software, devices, systems, and the way technology shapes things.
pathway_assessment_passion_music_descrip: Creative expression through sound, visuals, or performance is where you come alive.
pathway_assessment_passion_sports_descri: Physical challenge, competition, and active environments energize you.
pathway_assessment_passion_reading_descr: You spend real time with books, articles, or deep content — not just scrolling.
pathway_assessment_passion_science_descr: You want to understand how things really work — experiments, evidence, curiosity.
pathway_assessment_passion_social_descri: Human connection, social causes, and group dynamics genuinely interest you.
pathway_assessment_passion_nature_descri: You care about the natural world — outdoor environments, wildlife, or sustainability.
pathway_assessment_passion_building_desc: There is something satisfying about creating or assembling something real and useful.
pathway_assessment_passion_ideas_descrip: New concepts, future possibilities, and unconventional thinking light you up.
pathway_assessment_subjects_title: Which subject could you explain most confidently to someone else?
pathway_assessment_subjects_helper: Not your favorite — the one where you actually understand it well enough to teach it.
pathway_assessment_subject_math_descript: You think in patterns, logic, and structured calculation.
pathway_assessment_subject_science_descr: You are drawn to evidence, systems, and understanding how things work.
pathway_assessment_subject_writing_descr: You communicate ideas clearly and precisely — on paper or in words.
pathway_assessment_subject_arts_descript: You express and process ideas through visual, musical, or creative work.
pathway_assessment_subject_social_descri: You understand human behavior, culture, history, and how societies work.
pathway_assessment_learning_preference_t: How do you actually learn something new?
pathway_assessment_learning_preference_h: Think about the last skill you picked up — not how you think you should learn. Up to 3.
pathway_assessment_learning_pref_practic: You figure things out by doing them — trying, failing, and adjusting in real time.
pathway_assessment_learning_pref_courses: A clear curriculum, defined progression, and guided exercises work best for you.
pathway_assessment_learning_pref_researc: You go deep through documentation, books, and articles before you start building.
pathway_assessment_learning_pref_watchin: Watching someone work through a problem or demonstrate a technique clicks fastest.
pathway_assessment_learning_pref_teachin: You don't fully understand something until you've explained it to someone else.
pathway_assessment_work_style_title: On a productive day at work, what are you doing?
pathway_assessment_work_style_helper: Choose 1 or 2 — the work modes that feel most like you, not just what you are capable of.
pathway_assessment_workstyle_analyze_des: Working through data, evidence, and logic to reach a reliable conclusion.
pathway_assessment_workstyle_help_descri: Direct support, care, and service — your work has a clear human on the receiving end.
pathway_assessment_workstyle_build_descr: Creating, improving, or repairing something tangible and functional.
pathway_assessment_workstyle_create_desc: Open-ended problem-solving, invention, and bringing something new into existence.
pathway_assessment_workstyle_routine_des: You are most effective when the expectations are clear and the process is consistent.
pathway_assessment_environment_title: Where would you do your best work?
pathway_assessment_environment_helper: Think about the environment where you actually perform well, not where you wish you could work.
pathway_assessment_env_office_descriptio: Structured, collaborative, shared momentum — you want people around you.
pathway_assessment_env_remote_descriptio: Autonomy, location freedom, and the ability to design your own environment.
pathway_assessment_env_outdoor_descripti: Physical, field-based, or active environments — you need to move and do.
pathway_assessment_env_lab_description: A focused, specialized space for technical, scientific, or creative practice.
pathway_assessment_env_mixed_description: No single setting defines you — you do your best work when the context shifts.
pathway_assessment_collaboration_title: How do you prefer to work with other people?
pathway_assessment_collaboration_helper: This is about interaction density — not location. A remote worker can be in calls all day or alone all day.
pathway_assessment_collab_solo_descripti: Deep focus, clear ownership, and minimal interruption — you work best alone.
pathway_assessment_collab_small_team_des: A tight group of 3–6 people who know each other well and move together.
pathway_assessment_collab_large_team_des: Defined roles, shared goals, and the energy of a bigger organization.
pathway_assessment_collab_client_facing_: Regular interaction with the people you are directly serving or advising.
pathway_assessment_collab_community_desc: Your work connects with a broader audience, group, or public in a meaningful way.
pathway_assessment_impact_title: What would feel missing if your work did not include it?
pathway_assessment_impact_helper: Choose 1 or 2 — the things that would make the work feel hollow without them.
pathway_assessment_impact_create_descrip: You want the output of your work to make something easier, better, or possible.
pathway_assessment_impact_people_descrip: Real human interaction — support, guidance, or service — is central to your work.
pathway_assessment_impact_discover_descr: Research, exploration, and expanding what is known matters deeply to you.
pathway_assessment_impact_systems_descri: You want to keep critical infrastructure, processes, or operations running well.
pathway_assessment_impact_express_descri: Imagination, design, and creative expression belong at the center of your work.
pathway_assessment_goals_title: What would make your career feel like a success?
pathway_assessment_goals_helper: Only one — the outcome that, if it were missing, would make everything else feel incomplete.
pathway_assessment_goal_impact_descripti: Meaning and contribution matter most — you need to feel your work counts.
pathway_assessment_goal_money_descriptio: Strong income and long-term security are non-negotiable for you.
pathway_assessment_goal_balance_descript: You want work that fits your life — not a life that revolves around your work.
pathway_assessment_goal_growth_descripti: You're not satisfied staying at the same level — growth is a requirement, not a bonus.
pathway_assessment_goal_variety_descript: Repetition slows you down — you need work that evolves and keeps you sharp.
pathway_assessment_finish_description: AICA can now match your profile to ranked pathways, explain each match clearly, and build a personalized roadmap for where you want to go.
pathway_assessment_finish_helper: Submit your profile to see your recommendations.
pathway_profile_description: Strengths, interests, goals, and work preferences.
roadmap_setup_welcome_title: Let's set up your first action plan
roadmap_setup_welcome_helper: This will shape your next realistic roadmap window, not your full career timeline.
roadmap_setup_current_stage_high_school_: You are still in school and need a realistic starting direction.
roadmap_setup_current_stage_university_d: You are studying now and want a clearer path, stronger skills, or both.
roadmap_setup_current_stage_graduate_des: You finished formal study and want to move into the next real step.
roadmap_setup_current_stage_self_learnin: You are learning on your own and need structure, focus, and proof of progress.
roadmap_setup_current_stage_working_desc: You are already working and want to grow, switch, or reposition carefully.
roadmap_setup_weekly_time_title: How much focused time can you realistically give each week?
roadmap_setup_weekly_time_low_descriptio: Light pace for small consistent progress each week.
roadmap_setup_weekly_time_medium_descrip: Steady progress without burning out — fits most lifestyles and commitments.
roadmap_setup_weekly_time_high_descripti: Focused effort with faster visible progress.
roadmap_setup_weekly_time_intense_descri: An accelerated pace that needs strong weekly consistency.
roadmap_setup_timeline_title: How far should this roadmap plan ahead?
roadmap_setup_timeline_helper: For tech paths like frontend or backend development, 6–12 months can be your complete roadmap. For longer careers like civil engineering or medicine, the same window is your first major action phase — not your full timeline.
roadmap_setup_timeline_sprint_descriptio: A quick-start window — fast clarity, first wins, and immediate momentum.
roadmap_setup_timeline_short_description: One structured quarter — meaningful progress you can measure and build on.
roadmap_setup_timeline_medium_descriptio: Half-year plan — a complete roadmap for most tech and creative paths.
roadmap_setup_timeline_long_description: Full-year commitment — complete for self-contained paths, first major phase for complex careers.
roadmap_setup_constraints_low_budget_des: Prefer free or low-cost learning resources.
roadmap_setup_constraints_no_laptop_desc: Must work with mobile or limited devices.
roadmap_setup_constraints_inconsistent_s: Need a roadmap that can survive busy or unpredictable weeks.
roadmap_setup_roadmap_style_title: What kind of plan fits you best?
roadmap_setup_roadmap_style_fast_track_d: Jump into projects early — learn by building, not by waiting to feel ready.
roadmap_setup_roadmap_style_balanced_des: Mix fundamentals and practical work in a steady, sustainable way.
roadmap_setup_roadmap_style_deep_descrip: Go deeper on core understanding before pushing hard on speed.
roadmap_setup_finish_description: Submit to save your setup and continue.
roadmap_setup_description: Starting point, weekly time, constraints, and plan style.
update_roadmap_setup_description: You may need to regenerate your roadmap to use your updated preferences.
